task: The caller is about to act on a pending decision and wants to know whether it can be undone before deciding.
rationale: Plan now evaluates the actual undo cost of a pending decision using existing caller authority. Premortem challenges a supplied plan and should not win this narrower reversibility question. The pair remains reciprocal with rq-02, where premortem must win a plan-challenge request.
notes: Owner migrated from the retired one-way-door classifier; task, query, rank exclusions and token ceiling are unchanged. Historical ranker measurements remain measurements of the prior catalog.
